messages:
leah: posted an RFC for a notify-preset rollout assistant in the console. primary goals: safe migration from per-route notify defaults to SLO-level presets, clear quota impact, and a guided canary flow. PTAL.
ben: very needed. can you outline the guided steps?
leah: 1) auto-discover routes with custom per-route notifies 2) suggest candidate preset based on common channels and quiet windows 3) run a backend estimate for projected monthly notify units and sample routes 4) dry-run apply to a small sample 5) staged rollout (traffic% or stable route% hash) 6) finalize with audit log.
tim: prefer traffic% for fidelity, but route% is faster for quick checks. telemetry can return 7d rolling avg per-route so traffic% sampling is doable.
ben: API sketch please.
leah: POST /api/v1/tenants/:t/notify-presets/candidates -> generates suggestions. POST /api/v1/tenants/:t/notify-presets/:id/estimate?window=7d -> returns projected_units, sample_routes, traffic_pct. POST /.../:id/dry-run -> simulated_fanout and warnings. POST /.../:id/apply -> accepts rollout_policy.
notify-bot: telemetry estimator endpoint added: /telemetry/estimate_notify_fanout?tenant=...&preset_id=... returns projected_units:int, sample_routes:[id], traffic_pct:float, mismatch_hints:[str].
olivia: UX asks: show a red badge when projected_units > tenant_commit, show sample payload JSON for one sample route, and hide heavy estimates behind an explicit Run Estimate button.
ben: quota model: show projected bill if over reserve, and add an enforce_quota toggle (enforce vs warn).
tim: for rollout policy, support { type: stable-hash, percent, seed } and { type: traffic-percent, percent }. stable-hash should use route_id hashed with tenant salt.
leah: migration safety: do not auto-apply. UI will create candidate presets and show a migration assistant card per tenant; owners must approve and run dry-run before apply.
notify-bot: dry-run result for candidate 88: projected_units=420, sample_routes=[r-12,r-54,r-309,r-77,r-900], simulated_peak=35/s, warnings=["duplicate_channels"]
olivia: telemetry caveat: webhooks can be overcounted if downstream dedupes. include manual per-channel multiplier override in the preset UI and a billing note.
security-bot: for tenants labeled restricted require two approvers; add approver_flow metadata on preset.
ben: event contract request: emit events notify.preset.created, notify.preset.estimate, notify.preset.dry_run, notify.preset.apply with fields: preset_id, tenant_id, routes_count, projected_units, actual_units_sample, applied_by, rollout_policy.
leah: will add events and a periodic health job that compares projected vs actual over 72h and files a ticket if delta > 25%.
tim: backcompat: when converting per-route defaults, auto-create candidate presets but do not apply. console will show a migration checklist and a dry-run preview.
leah: thanks all. i'll update the RFC and open the draft PR with the APIs, telemetry specs, and UI mocks. will ping when ready. :rocket:
